notes: Phase 1 single-source unweighted distances via src/algorithms/paths/distances.rs. BFS-based scan; first-pop = shortest distance. ~3.6x slower than plain BFS (BFS karate = 693 ns) which is expected because each pop now also does a checked_add and writes Some(d+1). Linear scaling: ~52 ns/vertex on path graphs (n=1k → 52 µs; n=10k → 513 µs). Same per-vertex Vec alloc overhead as bfs/cc — fixable by a future neighbours-as-slice API.
